note: Knowledge shards built only from facts already published in this repository. Arm A sees none; arm B sees all three through one retrieval tool; arms C-E get one shard per agent. Union is identical for B-E.

premises.statement: Attestation nonces are claimed in a durable O_EXCL ledger after signature verification and before the effect runs; after a crash between claim and effect the same attestation is never executed again (at-most-once).
The passport registry is reloaded when its inode, size or mtime changes; a missing or invalid registry fails closed.
Attestation verification always returns authorityGranted:false; authority comes only from mandates, issuer grants and the human gate.
Backend releases are rolled out by restarting the backend process; in-flight requests are dropped on restart.
Several services are started without a supervisor that restarts them automatically after a crash.
Operators re-sign and resubmit dropped actions manually; there is no automatic retry queue.
In CE-01 all four conditions reached the maximum score on the transfer tasks.
The CE-01b automatic scorer used substring matching and counted abstentions such as 'I don't know' as correct 'no' answers.
In CE-01b the individual model overclaimed exactly on a fact that changed after its training data.
